title: The Copper Cuttlefish of Inkfast
description: On Inkfast, the village leaves every shell blank. At moonrise, the cuttlefish draws the only picture in the tide pool.
alt: A copper-colored cuttlefish hovers above a crescent of pale shells as dark ink fans out beneath the moonlit surface.
pairing: An imagined coastal holiday when ink is put away × a cuttlefish that paints the tide pool
